CloneProjectRequest.description: Add project, "Clone from GitHub": `repo` into `location/<repo name>`.

PromptProposalDto.description: A prompt edit the background review staged, beside the text it would replace.

stale.description: The active text changed after the proposal was written.

auth.description: How the User signs in: `login` (browser flow), `key` (pasted API key).

ctx_spill_enabled.description: Whether oversized tool output spills to `ctx:` handles and CCR replacement runs.

max_context_limit.description: Reference `compress.maxContextLimit`, a percent of the window.

protected_tools.description: Reference `compress.protectedTools`; results of these tools never fold.

skills_review_interval.description: Background skill review starts after this many tool-calling rounds since the last `skill_manage`; 0 turns it off.

variable.description: The stored key name the tools read.

UsageRecord.description:
One model request of a Session. `inputTokens` is the whole prompt (the context size);
`freshInputTokens` is the part that was neither a cache read nor a cache write.

at.description: Epoch milliseconds when the event was recorded.

fold.description:
A `compress` landed after the previous request and before this one, so the conversation
head changed and the provider's cached prompt restarted: the low hit is this request's cause.

hitPercent.description: `cachedTokens` as a percentage of the prompt (`cached + creation + fresh`); null when the prompt is empty.

UsageView.description: Read-only quota data. Credentials never leave the daemon.
